prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1096; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim you have opened. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, email, or mail. If our client is contacted in any form, please refer that person to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault party, along with a declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

Your insured and your company are under a duty to preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle data, and any communications concerning the loss. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or deleted while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps you have taken to preserve evidence.
